title: &#9700e4Steal the Scepter
description: §5This is it: your ultimate test. Bring me the Scepter and I will bring you to Skaia as we destroy the world together.

§5From the plans you gathered before, I discovered that Prospitian Rooks hold Key Fragments. Kill enough of them, gather their fragments and craft the Key needed to open the vault; which is apparently nearby below the throne, at &#FF1EEE-5 133 -362§5.
§5Bring me the Scepter. You can call for me if you interact with my throne.
